name: Omaloader
author: osia
description: Paste a video URL, see a preview, pick picture and sound quality (or convert to GIF), download with yt-dlp + ffmpeg. Settings tab with download options and a plugin-only proxy manager.

barWidget.description: A download button in the bar. Click it, paste any video URL, a preview loads, then choose picture quality (or none / GIF) and sound quality (or none) and hit download.
